answer: The strongest sybil defense is peer-prediction scoring: every grader is paid only when its judgment correlates with the independent grades of a random reference panel, so a fake willow identity submitting lazy or collusive grades earns nothing while real ocean-work graders keep cashing accuracy bonuses. Attacking means flooding the panel with coordinated fakes whose predictions must still beat honest walnut-grade noise, so each bot costs real compute and stake, and every detected collusion cluster forfeits its bond.
